name: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India)
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings runs events catering, banquets, casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens in India and the UAE, led by promoter Sanjay Manohar Vazirani. Revenue from operations grew from ₹377 cr in FY24 to ₹568 cr in FY26 and profit after tax roughly doubled to ₹29.1 cr in FY26, but the company lost ₹16.2 cr in the six months to September 2026. The RHP issue has a ₹192 cr fresh issue plus an offer for sale of 88.35 lakh shares; about 59% of the fresh money goes to a new kitchen, banquets and restaurants and about 11% to repaying debt. Pending tax and criminal cases involve the promoter and directors, and the price band had not been announced when this report was written, so valuation checks are open.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹377.2 cr (FY24) to ₹567.5 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 22.7%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew in FY25 (₹450.9 cr, +19.5%) and FY26 (₹567.5 cr, +25.9%).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.10 at 30 Sep 2026 (borrowings ₹22.4 cr vs net worth ₹216.0 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings fell from ₹35.3 cr (FY24) to ₹24.3 cr (FY26) while revenue rose about 50%.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose from ₹79.6 cr (FY24) to ₹106.2 cr (FY25) and ₹229.4 cr (FY26), then dipped to ₹216.0 cr at Sep 2026.

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹29.9 cr in FY26, about 103% of the ₹29.1 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew about 104% in FY26, from ₹14.3 cr to ₹29.1 cr, though the six months to Sep 2026 showed a ₹16.2 cr loss.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: PAT margin improved from -4.04% (FY24) to 3.13% (FY25) and 5.09% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 17.35% in FY26 (-7.25% for the six months to Sep 2026).

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was not found in public sources.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: The RHP lists restaurant companies only as references, not direct listed comparables, so no peer median applies.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: The price band has not been announced, so P/E cannot be compared.

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: The price band has not been announced, so price to book cannot be compared.

checks.finding: The price band has not been announced, so market cap to sales cannot be compared.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: Pre-IPO placements were made at ₹363 per share in March–May 2025, but share transfers in the last 12 months and the price band were not found.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 63.40% before the issue; the post-issue holding was not found.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: Related-party transactions were ₹9.25 cr in FY26, about 1.6% of revenue.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: Three tax and statutory cases (₹1.33 cr) are pending against the promoter and four criminal cases (₹3.00 cr) against directors.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The issue has a ₹192 cr fresh issue and an OFS of 88,35,382 shares, but the OFS value is unknown until the price band is set.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The issue size and post-issue market cap are not known until the price band is set.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: The promoter's average cost is ₹0.19 per share, but the price band has not been announced to compare it with.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹113.7 cr (about 59% of the ₹192 cr fresh issue) goes to a centralised kitchen, two banquets and four new restaurants.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: ₹21.0 cr, or about 11% of the fresh issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: The general corporate purposes amount was not stated; the RHP caps it at 25% of gross proceeds.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: Whether any repaid loans are from promoter entities was not found.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Cases against the company total ₹15.48 cr (about 7% of net worth), and a tax show-cause notice alleges a further ₹23.32 cr (about 11%).

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: Four criminal cases are pending against directors (₹3.00 cr) and one regulatory case against the company.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹4.51 cr at 30 Sep 2026, about 2% of net worth.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top-10 customer share was not found; the largest customer gave 18.75% of FY26 revenue.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: The top 10 suppliers made up 19.80% of material costs in the six months to Sep 2026.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: The company was incorporated in 2015, about 11 years ago; its predecessor business dates to 2003.

checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
